audit_items.proof_trace: Production build has TOCTOU race: MaxBlobsPerBlock() performs check-then-sort on shared BlobSchedule slice without synchronization. Concurrent P2P validation threads can trigger simultaneous in-place sorting via slices.SortFunc(), causing slice corruption, wrong max blob value returned, or panic. Develop build has RLock protection, but production (config_utils_prod.go) has no mutex.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends multiple blocks simultaneously via P2P to trigger concurrent MaxBlobsPerBlock() calls. If BlobSchedule unsorted, all threads enter sorting path causing data race on shared slice. Results in: (1) validator crash via panic, (2) wrong max value causing DoS on legitimate blocks, or (3) oversized blocks accepted.
